stages.name: nodes
stages.query:
SELECT *,kind||':'||__start||':'||__end AS id,
 parent_kind||':'||parent_start||':'||parent_end AS parent,
 ancestor_kind||':'||ancestor_start||':'||ancestor_end AS edge_parent,
 row_number() OVER(PARTITION BY __path,parent_start,parent_end,parent_kind ORDER BY __start,__end,kind)-1 AS ordinal
 FROM (SELECT * FROM syntax_rows_0 UNION ALL SELECT * FROM syntax_rows_1)

stages.name: edges
stages.query: SELECT __path,edge_parent AS src,id AS dst,ordinal FROM nodes WHERE edge_parent IS NOT NULL

stages.name: fields
stages.query: SELECT __path,id AS owner,'value' AS role,value_kind||':'||value_start||':'||value_end AS child FROM nodes WHERE value_start IS NOT NULL

stages.name: functions
stages.query: SELECT n.*,n.name_source AS name FROM nodes n WHERE n.kind='function_definition'

stages.name: ownership
stages.query:
WITH RECURSIVE owned(__path,id,fn,cls,top_fn) AS (
 SELECT n.__path,n.id,CASE WHEN n.kind='function_definition' THEN n.id END,CASE WHEN n.kind='class_definition' THEN n.id END,CASE WHEN n.kind='function_definition' THEN n.id END FROM nodes n
 LEFT JOIN nodes parent ON parent.__path=n.__path AND parent.id=n.edge_parent WHERE parent.id IS NULL
 UNION ALL SELECT child.__path,child.id,CASE WHEN child.kind='function_definition' THEN child.id ELSE owned.fn END,CASE WHEN child.kind='class_definition' THEN child.id ELSE owned.cls END,CASE WHEN owned.top_fn IS NULL AND child.kind='function_definition' THEN child.id ELSE owned.top_fn END
 FROM owned JOIN edges e ON e.__path=owned.__path AND e.src=owned.id
 JOIN nodes child ON child.__path=e.__path AND child.id=e.dst) SELECT * FROM owned

stages.name: attributes
stages.query: SELECT n.*,a.text AS attr,o.id AS object,o.text AS object_text FROM nodes n JOIN nodes a ON a.__path=n.__path AND a.id=n.attribute_kind||':'||n.attribute_start||':'||n.attribute_end JOIN nodes o ON o.__path=n.__path AND o.id=n.object_kind||':'||n.object_start||':'||n.object_end WHERE n.kind='attribute'

stages.name: calls
stages.query: SELECT n.*,f.id AS callee_id,f.kind AS callee_kind,coalesce(a.attr,f.text) AS callee,a.object AS receiver FROM nodes n JOIN nodes f ON f.__path=n.__path AND f.id=n.function_kind||':'||n.function_start||':'||n.function_end LEFT JOIN attributes a ON a.__path=f.__path AND a.id=f.id WHERE n.kind='call'

stages.name: arguments
stages.query: SELECT n.*,c.id AS call,row_number() OVER(PARTITION BY c.__path,c.id ORDER BY n.__start)-1 AS position FROM calls c JOIN nodes n ON n.__path=c.__path AND n.parent=c.arguments_kind||':'||c.arguments_start||':'||c.arguments_end WHERE n.kind NOT IN ('comment','keyword_argument','list_splat','dictionary_splat')

stages.name: descendants
stages.query: WITH RECURSIVE walk(__path,root,node) AS (SELECT __path,id,id FROM nodes UNION SELECT w.__path,w.root,e.dst FROM walk w JOIN edges e ON e.__path=w.__path AND e.src=w.node) SELECT * FROM walk

stages.name: executor_types
stages.query:
WITH RECURSIVE types(__path,name) AS (
 SELECT DISTINCT __path,'BackendExecutor' FROM nodes
 UNION SELECT n.__path,coalesce(rx_extract(n.text,'\bas\s+([A-Za-z_]\w*)$',1),rx_extract(n.text,'([A-Za-z_]\w*)$',1)) FROM nodes n
 WHERE n.kind IN ('aliased_import','dotted_name') AND rx_matches(n.text,'(?:^|\b)[A-Za-z_]*BackendExecutor(?:\s+as\s+[A-Za-z_]\w*)?$')
 UNION SELECT n.__path,l.text FROM nodes n JOIN nodes l ON l.__path=n.__path AND l.id=n.left_kind||':'||n.left_start||':'||n.left_end
 JOIN nodes r ON r.__path=n.__path AND r.id=n.right_kind||':'||n.right_start||':'||n.right_end JOIN types t ON t.__path=n.__path AND t.name=r.text WHERE n.kind='assignment' AND l.kind='identifier' AND r.kind='identifier'
 UNION SELECT n.__path,rx_extract(n.text,'^class\s+([A-Za-z_]\w*)',1) FROM nodes n JOIN types t ON t.__path=n.__path WHERE n.kind='class_definition' AND rx_matches(n.text,'^class\s+\w+\([^\n:]*\b'||t.name||'\b')
 ) SELECT * FROM types

stages.name: annotation_edges
stages.query:
SELECT child.__path,child.id AS src,parent.id AS dst FROM nodes parent JOIN nodes child ON child.__path=parent.__path AND child.parent=parent.id
 WHERE parent.kind IN ('type','parenthesized_expression','union_type') OR parent.kind='binary_operator' AND instr(parent.text,'|')>0
 UNION SELECT arg.__path,arg.id,generic.id FROM nodes generic JOIN nodes head ON head.__path=generic.__path AND head.parent=generic.id AND head.ordinal=0 JOIN nodes arg ON arg.__path=generic.__path AND arg.parent=generic.id AND arg.ordinal>0
 WHERE generic.kind='subscript' AND rx_matches(head.text,'(?:^|\.)(?:Annotated|Awaitable|Coroutine|Optional)$')
 UNION SELECT child.__path,child.id,generic.id FROM nodes generic JOIN nodes head ON head.__path=generic.__path AND head.parent=generic.id AND head.ordinal=0 JOIN nodes params ON params.__path=generic.__path AND params.parent=generic.id AND params.kind='type_parameter' JOIN nodes child ON child.__path=params.__path AND child.parent=params.id
 WHERE generic.kind='generic_type' AND rx_matches(head.text,'(?:^|\.)(?:Annotated|Awaitable|Coroutine|Optional)$') AND (SELECT count(*) FROM nodes element WHERE element.__path=params.__path AND element.parent=params.id AND element.kind!='comment')=1

stages.name: annotations
stages.query:
WITH RECURSIVE accepted(__path,id) AS (SELECT n.__path,n.id FROM nodes n WHERE
 (n.kind='identifier' AND (n.text IN (SELECT name FROM executor_types t WHERE t.__path=n.__path) OR n.text LIKE '%BackendExecutor'))
 OR (n.kind='attribute' AND (n.attribute_source IN (SELECT name FROM executor_types t WHERE t.__path=n.__path) OR n.attribute_source LIKE '%BackendExecutor'))
 OR (n.kind='string' AND rx_matches(n.text,'(?:^|[\x22\x27| ])(?:[A-Za-z_]\w*\.)*(?:[A-Za-z_]\w*BackendExecutor|BackendExecutor)(?:[\x22\x27| ]|$)'))
 UNION SELECT a.__path,e.dst FROM accepted a JOIN annotation_edges e ON e.__path=a.__path AND e.src=a.id) SELECT * FROM accepted

stages.name: factories
stages.query: SELECT DISTINCT f.__path,f.name FROM functions f JOIN annotations a ON a.__path=f.__path AND a.id=f.return_type_kind||':'||f.return_type_start||':'||f.return_type_end UNION SELECT DISTINCT __path,'_create_backend_executor' FROM nodes

stages.name: bindings
stages.query:
SELECT n.__path,n.id,n.__start,l.id AS target,r.id AS value,o.fn FROM nodes n JOIN nodes l ON l.__path=n.__path AND l.id=n.left_kind||':'||n.left_start||':'||n.left_end
 JOIN nodes r ON r.__path=n.__path AND r.id=n.right_kind||':'||n.right_start||':'||n.right_end LEFT JOIN ownership o ON o.__path=n.__path AND o.id=n.id
 WHERE n.kind IN ('assignment','for_statement','for_in_clause')
 UNION SELECT n.__path,n.id,n.__start,l.id,r.id,o.fn FROM nodes n JOIN nodes l ON l.__path=n.__path AND l.id=n.name_kind||':'||n.name_start||':'||n.name_end
 JOIN nodes r ON r.__path=n.__path AND r.id=n.value_kind||':'||n.value_start||':'||n.value_end LEFT JOIN ownership o ON o.__path=n.__path AND o.id=n.id WHERE n.kind='named_expression'

stages.name: name_sites
stages.query:
SELECT n.__path,n.id,n.text,n.__start,o.fn,f.__start AS fn_start,f.__end AS fn_end,
 EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM bindings store WHERE store.__path=n.__path AND store.target=n.id) AS is_store,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM bindings b JOIN nodes t ON t.__path=b.__path AND t.id=b.target WHERE b.__path=n.__path AND b.fn=o.fn AND t.text=n.text) AS binding_count,
 (SELECT b.target FROM bindings b JOIN nodes t ON t.__path=b.__path AND t.id=b.target WHERE b.__path=n.__path AND b.fn=o.fn AND t.text=n.text AND b.__start<n.__start ORDER BY b.__start DESC LIMIT 1) AS latest_target
 FROM nodes n JOIN ownership o ON o.__path=n.__path AND o.id=n.id JOIN functions f ON f.__path=o.__path AND f.id=o.fn WHERE n.kind='identifier'

stages.name: propagation
stages.query:
SELECT __path,object AS src,id AS dst FROM attributes
 UNION SELECT n.__path,c.id,n.id FROM nodes n JOIN nodes c ON c.__path=n.__path AND c.parent=n.id
 WHERE n.kind IN ('parenthesized_expression','type','await','unary_operator','list','tuple','set','list_splat','expression_list','pattern_list')
 UNION SELECT n.__path,c.id,n.id FROM nodes n JOIN nodes c ON c.__path=n.__path AND c.parent=n.id
 WHERE n.kind IN ('boolean_operator','conditional_expression') AND (n.kind!='conditional_expression' OR c.ordinal IN (0,2))
 UNION SELECT n.__path,c.id,n.id FROM nodes n JOIN fields f ON f.__path=n.__path AND f.owner=n.id AND f.role='value' JOIN nodes c ON c.__path=n.__path AND c.id=f.child WHERE n.kind IN ('pair','named_expression')
 UNION SELECT n.__path,c.id,n.id FROM nodes n JOIN nodes c ON c.__path=n.__path AND c.parent=n.id WHERE n.kind='dictionary'
 UNION SELECT c.__path,c.receiver,c.id FROM calls c WHERE c.receiver IS NOT NULL AND c.callee NOT IN ('async_pipeline_execution_scope','get_lowering_context','native_pipeline_execution_receipt','pipeline_execution_scope')
 UNION SELECT c.__path,a.id,c.id FROM calls c JOIN arguments a ON a.__path=c.__path AND a.call=c.id AND a.position=0 WHERE c.callee='getattr'
 UNION SELECT b.__path,b.value,b.target FROM bindings b JOIN nodes l ON l.__path=b.__path AND l.id=b.target WHERE l.kind NOT IN ('pattern_list','tuple_pattern','list_pattern')
 UNION SELECT b.__path,rv.id,lt.id FROM bindings b JOIN nodes l ON l.__path=b.__path AND l.id=b.target JOIN nodes r ON r.__path=b.__path AND r.id=b.value
 JOIN nodes lt ON lt.__path=l.__path AND lt.parent=l.id JOIN nodes rv ON rv.__path=r.__path AND rv.parent=r.id AND rv.ordinal=lt.ordinal
 WHERE l.kind IN ('pattern_list','tuple_pattern','list_pattern') AND r.kind IN ('expression_list','tuple','list')
 UNION SELECT b.__path,b.value,lt.id FROM bindings b JOIN nodes l ON l.__path=b.__path AND l.id=b.target JOIN nodes r ON r.__path=b.__path AND r.id=b.value JOIN nodes lt ON lt.__path=l.__path AND lt.parent=l.id
 WHERE l.kind IN ('pattern_list','tuple_pattern','list_pattern') AND r.kind NOT IN ('expression_list','tuple','list')
 UNION SELECT p.__path,p.id,n.id FROM name_sites p JOIN name_sites n ON n.__path=p.__path AND n.text=p.text
 WHERE NOT n.is_store AND p.fn_start<=n.fn_start AND p.fn_end>=n.fn_end AND (p.fn=n.fn OR n.binding_count=0)
 AND (n.binding_count<=1 OR p.id=n.latest_target)
 UNION SELECT m.__path,m.subject_kind||':'||m.subject_start||':'||m.subject_end,n.id FROM nodes m
 JOIN descendants d ON d.__path=m.__path AND d.root=m.id JOIN nodes n ON n.__path=d.__path AND n.id=d.node JOIN nodes p ON p.__path=n.__path AND p.id=n.parent
 WHERE m.kind='match_statement' AND n.kind='identifier' AND (p.kind IN ('as_pattern','splat_pattern') OR (p.kind='dotted_name' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM nodes cp WHERE cp.__path=p.__path AND cp.id=p.parent AND cp.kind='case_pattern' AND rx_matches(cp.text,'^[A-Za-z_]\w*$'))))
 UNION SELECT p.__path,p.id,n.id FROM attributes p JOIN attributes n ON n.__path=p.__path AND n.attr=p.attr WHERE p.object_text IN ('self','cls') AND n.object_text IN ('self','cls')

stages.name: subscripts
stages.query: SELECT n.*,c.id AS container,c.kind AS container_kind,c.text AS container_text FROM nodes n JOIN nodes c ON c.__path=n.__path AND c.parent=n.id AND c.ordinal=0 WHERE n.kind='subscript'

stages.name: carrier_edges
stages.query:
SELECT s.__path,s.container AS src,s.id AS dst FROM subscripts s WHERE s.container_kind NOT IN ('list','tuple','dictionary')
 UNION SELECT s.__path,e.id,s.id FROM subscripts s JOIN nodes indexer ON indexer.__path=s.__path AND indexer.parent=s.id AND indexer.ordinal=1 JOIN nodes e ON e.__path=s.__path AND e.parent=s.container
 WHERE s.container_kind IN ('list','tuple') AND indexer.kind='integer' AND e.ordinal=CAST(indexer.text AS INTEGER)
 UNION SELECT s.__path,v.id,s.id FROM subscripts s JOIN nodes indexer ON indexer.__path=s.__path AND indexer.parent=s.id AND indexer.ordinal=1
 JOIN nodes pair ON pair.__path=s.__path AND pair.parent=s.container JOIN nodes k ON k.__path=pair.__path AND k.parent=pair.id AND k.ordinal=0 JOIN nodes v ON v.__path=pair.__path AND v.parent=pair.id AND v.ordinal=1
 WHERE s.container_kind='dictionary' AND k.text=indexer.text

stages.name: owner_seeds
stages.query:
SELECT n.__path,n.id FROM nodes n JOIN nodes p ON p.__path=n.__path AND p.id=n.parent
 WHERE n.kind='identifier' AND ((p.kind='parameters' AND n.text IN ('backend','executor')) OR (p.kind IN ('typed_parameter','typed_default_parameter') AND n.ordinal=0 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM annotations a WHERE a.__path=p.__path AND a.id=p.type_kind||':'||p.type_start||':'||p.type_end)))
 UNION SELECT c.__path,c.id FROM calls c WHERE c.callee IN (SELECT name FROM factories f WHERE f.__path=c.__path) OR c.callee IN (SELECT name FROM executor_types t WHERE t.__path=c.__path) OR rx_matches(c.callee,'(?i)backend_executor')
 UNION SELECT c.__path,c.id FROM calls c JOIN arguments a ON a.__path=c.__path AND a.call=c.id AND a.position=0 JOIN annotations t ON t.__path=a.__path AND t.id=a.id WHERE c.callee='cast'
 UNION SELECT l.__path,l.id FROM nodes n JOIN nodes l ON l.__path=n.__path AND l.id=n.left_kind||':'||n.left_start||':'||n.left_end JOIN annotations a ON a.__path=n.__path AND a.id=n.type_kind||':'||n.type_start||':'||n.type_end WHERE n.kind='assignment'
 UNION SELECT a.__path,a.id FROM attributes a JOIN nodes n ON n.__path=a.__path AND n.kind='assignment' JOIN nodes l ON l.__path=n.__path AND l.id=n.left_kind||':'||n.left_start||':'||n.left_end JOIN annotations t ON t.__path=n.__path AND t.id=n.type_kind||':'||n.type_start||':'||n.type_end WHERE l.kind='identifier' AND l.text=a.attr AND a.object_text IN ('self','cls') AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM nodes cls WHERE cls.__path=n.__path AND cls.kind='class_definition' AND rx_matches(cls.text,'^class BaseServerPlan\b') AND cls.__start<n.__start AND cls.__end>n.__end)

stages.name: owners
stages.query:
WITH RECURSIVE all_edges AS (SELECT * FROM propagation UNION SELECT * FROM carrier_edges), owners(__path,id) AS (
 SELECT * FROM owner_seeds UNION SELECT o.__path,e.dst FROM owners o JOIN all_edges e ON e.__path=o.__path AND e.src=o.id) SELECT * FROM owners

relational.query: SELECT n.__path AS path,n.__start AS start_byte,n.__end AS end_byte,'SPD001' AS issue,'family'||n.id AS identity FROM attributes n WHERE n.attr IN ('is_document_backend','is_graph_backend','is_mysql_family','is_sql_backend') UNION ALL SELECT n.__path AS path,n.__start AS start_byte,n.__end AS end_byte,'SPD005' AS issue,'attribute'||n.id AS identity FROM attributes n WHERE n.__path='impl/common/l2070_server_plan/base_server_plan.py' AND (n.attr IN ('_async_conn','_conn','native_pipeline','native_pipeline_async') OR (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM owners own WHERE own.__path=n.__path AND own.id=n.object) AND n.attr NOT IN ('async_pipeline_execution_scope','get_lowering_context','native_pipeline_execution_receipt','pipeline_execution_scope'))) UNION ALL SELECT n.__path AS path,n.__start AS start_byte,n.__end AS end_byte,'SPD005' AS issue,'subscript'||n.id AS identity FROM subscripts n WHERE n.__path='impl/common/l2070_server_plan/base_server_plan.py' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM owners own WHERE own.__path=n.__path AND own.id=n.id) UNION ALL SELECT n.__path AS path,n.__start AS start_byte,n.__end AS end_byte,'SPD005' AS issue,'escape'||n.id AS identity FROM nodes n WHERE n.__path='impl/common/l2070_server_plan/base_server_plan.py' AND n.kind IN ('return_statement','yield') AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ownership own JOIN functions f ON f.__path=own.__path AND f.id=own.fn WHERE own.__path=n.__path AND own.id=n.id AND f.name='_create_backend_executor') AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM nodes x JOIN owners own ON own.__path=x.__path AND own.id=x.id WHERE x.__path=n.__path AND x.parent=n.id AND x.kind='identifier') UNION ALL SELECT n.__path AS path,n.__start AS start_byte,n.__end AS end_byte,'SPD005' AS issue,'store'||n.id AS identity FROM nodes n WHERE n.__path='impl/common/l2070_server_plan/base_server_plan.py' AND n.kind='assignment' AND n.left_kind IN ('attribute','subscript') AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM owners own WHERE own.__path=n.__path AND own.id=n.right_kind||':'||n.right_start||':'||n.right_end) UNION ALL SELECT n.__path AS path,n.__start AS start_byte,n.__end AS end_byte,'SPD005' AS issue,'compare'||n.id AS identity FROM nodes n WHERE n.__path='impl/common/l2070_server_plan/base_server_plan.py' AND n.kind='comparison_operator' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ownership own JOIN functions f ON f.__path=own.__path AND f.id=own.fn WHERE own.__path=n.__path AND own.id=n.id AND f.name='_create_backend_executor') AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM nodes x JOIN owners own ON own.__path=x.__path AND own.id=x.id WHERE x.__path=n.__path AND x.parent=n.id) UNION ALL SELECT n.__path AS path,n.__start AS start_byte,n.__end AS end_byte,'SPD005' AS issue,'call'||n.id AS identity FROM calls n WHERE n.__path='impl/common/l2070_server_plan/base_server_plan.py' AND ((n.callee IN ('delattr','getattr','getattr_static','hasattr','setattr','vars','__getattribute__') AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM arguments a JOIN owners own ON own.__path=a.__path AND own.id=a.id WHERE a.__path=n.__path AND a.call=n.id AND a.position=0) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM arguments a WHERE a.__path=n.__path AND a.call=n.id AND a.position=1 AND trim(a.text,char(34)||char(39)) IN ('async_pipeline_execution_scope','get_lowering_context','native_pipeline_execution_receipt','pipeline_execution_scope'))) OR (n.callee_kind!='attribute' AND n.callee NOT IN ('PlanExecutor','attrgetter','cast','delattr','getattr','getattr_static','hasattr','run_executable_pipeline','run_executable_pipeline_async','setattr','vars') AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM arguments a JOIN owners own ON own.__path=a.__path AND own.id=a.id WHERE a.__path=n.__path AND a.call=n.id)))
